title: Man Resorts To Pure Rage After Failing To Outsmart Cops
description:
On April 25th, 2022, dispatch received a call regarding a vehicle going at an uncontrolled speed and swerving on the road. The caller gave accurate details to the police that led them to the car. Here's what the female told the police. Soon, the officer found the car, and the driver seemed intoxicated. The man kept arguing with the cops about the nine steps which was only going to get him in more trouble. The man was not ready to cooperate with the officers and kept interrupting them every time they were trying to explain the situation. Even after being arrested, the man remained uncooperative and continued to interrupt the officers whenever they tried to reason with him. Soon after being transported to the jail, the man started complaining about being in severe pain. The man was charged with the following offenses: DWI, open container in a motor vehicle, improper method of turning at intersections, driving on roadways laned for traffic, resisting arrest, and concealing identity.

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
